messages.content: Write a recap post about what a team learned at an industry conference. Around 250 words.

output:
I don't have any details about the conference, the team, or what was actually learned there — I don't want to invent a fake conference recap with made-up sessions or takeaways. Could you give me:

- Conference name and dates
- Who attended (team/role)
- 2-3 key things they actually learned or want highlighted
- Intended audience/publish location (company blog, internal doc, etc.)

Once I have those, I'll draft the ~250-word recap.
